contracts.commit_point: AuthenticationMiddleware.dispatch returns the 401/403 JSONResponse in place of call_next(request) for requests failing the token/order checks — rejection returns at middleware.py lines 130, 133, 152-154, 178, 181, 184; call_next is reached only at line 186 after successful validation. The middleware ordering comment at app.py 264-265 places Auth before the Handler in the stack.
contracts.declared_mechanism: AuthenticationMiddleware (Starlette BaseHTTPMiddleware) added via app.add_middleware(AuthenticationMiddleware) in create_app. Its dispatch consults PROTECTED_PATHS/PUBLIC_PATHS via _is_public, extracts the Bearer token, delegates to TokenIntrospector.validate_token, which POSTs the token to the Red Hat SSO introspection endpoint using the agent's client credentials (RFC 7662 pattern) and enforces active/required-scope/disallowed-scope checks; the middleware then resolves and validates the marketplace order via the DCR client and entitlement repositories. Failures yield JSON-RPC 401 (_unauthorized_response, code -32001, WWW-Authenticate: Bearer) or 403 (_forbidden_response, code -32003) without invoking call_next. Reinforced by Settings model validators _block_skip_jwt_in_production and _block_skip_order_in_production raising ValueError when the respective skip flags are set with K_SERVICE present, and by TokenIntrospector._validate_scope_config rejecting empty or inconsistent scope configuration in production.
contracts.forbidden_condition: Any POST / request proceeding to the A2A handler without a validly introspected Bearer token: missing Authorization header, non-Bearer Authorization format, introspection-reported inactive token, introspection endpoint failure (non-200 or transport error), missing required scope(s), disallowed scope(s) outside the allowlist, or — when order validation is enabled — no resolvable DCR client or no active entitlement for the token's client_id.

contracts.protection_obligation: Requests to the A2A JSON-RPC 2.0 endpoint (POST /) must present a Bearer token that passes Red Hat SSO introspection (token active, all scopes in AGENT_REQUIRED_SCOPE present, no scopes outside AGENT_ALLOWED_SCOPES) and, unless skip_order_validation is set, resolve to a DCR-registered client with an active marketplace entitlement; otherwise the request must be rejected with 401/403 before reaching the A2A handler. Enforcement is via AuthenticationMiddleware registered on the FastAPI app in create_app, reinforced by fail-fast Settings validators that forbid SKIP_JWT_VALIDATION and SKIP_ORDER_VALIDATION in Cloud Run production (K_SERVICE set). (Merged from the phase-one and phase-two reviewer wordings, which describe the same obligation.)
scope_limits: Only POST requests to path '/' are guarded; GET / and the PUBLIC_PATHS set (/docs, /openapi., /redoc, /.well-known/agent., /.well-known/agent-card., /marketplace/pubsub) bypass authentication (middleware.py 84-95, 188-199).

skip_jwt_validation=true bypasses token validation entirely outside Cloud Run (dev user synthesized; unvalidated token passed through for downstream forwarding); it is only prevented in production by the K_SERVICE fail-fast validator, so non-Cloud-Run deployments declare no guard against this bypass (middleware.py 120-125, 202-222; settings.py 467-470, 514-527).
skip_order_validation=true skips only the order/entitlement check while introspection still runs; likewise blocked in Cloud Run only (middleware.py 142-146; settings.py 471-477, 549-562).
Declared behavior is fail-closed for introspection transport/non-200 errors, which raise TokenValidationError mapped to 401 (introspection.py 164-179; middleware.py 182-184).
CORS, rate limiting, security headers, and request-body-size middleware are separate obligations and are not part of this contract (app.py 249, 254-258, 260-295).
